name: Caterpillar - Seguin TX Engine Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (diesel & gas engine assembly, ~1.7M sq ft)

fieldNotes.site: Confirmed via Street View - 'CATERPILLAR' wall signage on the office building along W Kingsbury St. This is the Caterpillar Seguin Engine Plant (1600 W Kingsbury St), a ~1.7M sq ft diesel & gas engine assembly plant employing ~2,000. Roster geocode (29.573587, -97.994251, ROOFTOP, moved 18m) is precise and lands on the plant complex.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Very large secured manufacturing campus bordered by I-10. Truck operations (dock banks, trailer staging, component yards) are concentrated on the NW side behind the plant. A truck-route access controls entry; a small booth-like structure is visible at the NW truck yard. truckGate set true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small light-colored booth-like structure sits at the NW truck-yard area beside a row of trailers backed in - classed as a guard shack at medium confidence; flagged.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Extremely wide truck yards and multiple access roads give ample room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks confirmed on the NW/west building faces with many trailers backed in. 50+ band; exact count low confidence given the plant's scale.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Vast trailer/component staging yards on the NW with well over 100 trailers and rows of components/material; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple dock banks on different building faces (NW and west) handle separate flows.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck routes around an enormous building - ample queueing room.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple access roads/gates serve the campus (employee side off W Kingsbury, truck side on the NW) - entry and exit are at distinct points.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Several distinct large buildings on one ~168-acre campus (main engine plant, satellite buildings, large component/staging areas).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Seguin TX off I-10 amid farmland; classed Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property identified.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left false.
fieldNotes.metrics: Counts are honest estimates from overhead imagery of a 1.7M sq ft engine plant; flagged.
